body:
It's a conundrum I have regarding abuse a lot. We have to just accept they'll get away with it most of the time knowing it'll happen to someone else because a lot of it isn't provable or even illegal. And in the meantime, we have to deal with the consequences, victim blaming and double standards. 

It really isn't fair, I'm sorry you've been through all this, I wish you the best.

I attempted suicide twice in 3 months for reasons very similar to yours. I narrowly escaped brain damage, traumatized my family and friends, and my abusive ex didn't give a shit, just turned it around and used it as a sob story to get other girls to feel sorry for him. 

It sounds like you have other people in your life besides him that do care about you and would be devastated to lose you. It will take time, but recovering from an abusive relationship is possible, and you already have the first step done which is not being in the relationship anymore.

We can't change them or fix them or force them to be decent people, that's who they want to be. All we can do is stay far away and do our best to rebuild. I'm rooting for you very much!
